final class RoomNavUITests: XCTestCase {
    func testOpenTeamStandupRoomInfo() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        let room = app.staticTexts["Team Standup"]
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Team Standup is not visible")

    }
}
